## Smartprop Editor
* Improved loading speed of the property editor
* Added copy and paste for properties; selecting a property opens it in the property editor
* Added dynamic isolation toggle
* Viewport selection highlight now has an X-ray effect
* Updated properties and elements from CS2 Schemas

## Git sync

* Added option to disable autogenerated commit messages

* Redesigned UI
